name: product-demo-video
description: Turns a product URL into a launch or demo video rendered from code, with real screenshots, beat-synced sound and a self-critique loop.

interface.shortDescription: Product URL in, launch video out, rendered from code
interface.longDescription: Captures your real product, plans shots on a beat grid, animates a deterministic canvas film in the Opus 5.5 motion style (one continuous take, 3D UI, flood and iris transitions), scores its own frames until every score is 8+, and renders 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 MP4s with music, sound effects and an optional voiceover.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second launch video for https://example.com
Turn our app's dashboard into a 15-second product reel
